top_signals.title: Bank of Canada Raises Interest Rates to 2.5%, First Hike Since 2023
top_signals.summary: The Bank of Canada raised its benchmark overnight interest rate by 25 basis points to 2.5% on Wednesday. It's the first  increase since July of 2023.  Governor Tiff Macklem says this move could reduce inflation risks posed by higher energy prices.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary:
The Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration has removed more than 10,000 training providers from its registry since December 2025, officials said.
